_schema.note: Shared SFX library manifest. Read by tools/mix_sfx.py (id -> file) and the sound-design skill. Written/extended by tools/gen_sfx.py (ElevenLabs sound-generation) or gen_sfx.py --import for royalty-free clips. Clips live in media/library/sfx/clips/ and are NOT committed (binary); regenerate with `python3 -I tools/gen_sfx.py`. Clips are loudness-normalized to ref_lufs with a peak ceiling so a plan's per-cue gain_db is perceptually meaningful; mix_sfx.py adds (ref_lufs - loudness_lufs) when a clip could not reach the target (short transients hit the ceiling first).

fields.id: stable generic name, kebab-case, named by FUNCTION not by scene (whoosh-soft, not intro-swipe)
fields.category: motion | tension | emphasis | snap | money | reward | ui | foley | texture
fields.function: what the cue does on screen: motion / tension / emphasis / snap (see sound-design skill)
fields.peak_s: seconds from clip start to the perceptual hit — mix_sfx.py subtracts this so at_s is where the HIT lands, not where the file starts
fields.loudness_lufs: integrated loudness after normalization (null when ebur128 gated a sub-second transient)
fields.license: who owns it and under what terms (record it or do not ship it)
fields.prompt: the generation prompt (so the clip can be regenerated or varied)
fields.used_in: episode ids that used it (library compounds across episodes)
